definitions.full: H6950. qahal [ קָהַל ] verb denominative (Gerber 107f. ) assemble as a קָהָל ; — Niph`al Perfect 3masculine plural נִקְהֲלוּ Est 9:2-3 t.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּקָּהֵל Exod 32:1 ; Jer 26:9 ; 3 masculine plural וַיִּקָּֽהֲלוּ 2Sam 20:14 Qr (Kt ויקלהו , compare HPS), etc.; Infinitive construct הִקָּהֵל Num 17:7 ; Est 8:11 ; Participle plural נִקְהָלִים Ezek 38:7 ; — assemble as a קָהָל : 1. a. for conflict or war 2Sam 20:14 (Qr; see above), Est 8:11 ; 9:2 , 15 , 16 , 18 ; with עַל person Ezek 38:7 , accusative of location Josh 22:12 ; Judg 20:1 . b. rebellion, with עַל person Num 16:3 ; 17:7 ; 20:2 (P), possibly also Exod 32:1 (J; most, unto Aaron). 2 for religious purposes: to erect tent of meeting, accusative of location Josh 18:1 (P); hear word of ׳י , with אֶל location Lev 8:4 (P), ב location + אֶל person Jer 26:9 ; for festival, אֶל person 1Kin 8:2 2Chr 5:3 ; לְ local 20:26 .
